criteria.always_lazy: Nobody reads ahead: the handler's first payload touch performs the one and only wire consumption. Buffered helpers fill memory within the cap from that touch; the reader helper yields the raw stream. Over-cap payloads become handler-visible failures, and the unconditional 413 goes away.
criteria.eager_only: The adapter keeps swallowing each payload before routing, capped as now, with over-cap payloads answered by the unconditional pre-handler 413. Stream readers project the swallowed copy, keeping memory capped while forfeiting genuine wire pacing; documentation owns that tradeoff.
criteria.route_marked: Ordinary routes inherit today's swallow-first path with its unconditional pre-handler 413, while a route-level streaming flag switches a route to untouched bodies that the handler drains exactly once via a reader. One flag operation is the whole selection mechanism.

body_mode.instructions: Which selection mechanism should split buffered from live request ingestion?

criteria.buffered_repeatable: Buffered helpers stay idempotent against retained bytes and the reader helper stays single-use per request. Live opening poisons later buffered helpers with a consumed-body failure, while buffered-first histories let the reader echo retained bytes.
criteria.mode_exclusive: First touch chooses sides for the whole request: buffered helpers choose the buffered side, reader creation chooses the live side, and the opposite side then refuses. Buffered repeats pass; the reader opens once.
criteria.single_shot: One touch exhausts the payload under every helper: buffered, decoded and reader access all arms the consumed latch, and all repeats trip it. Handlers hoist the payload into one binding.

consumption.instructions: How strict must the anti-reread discipline be?

criteria.callback_fold: A unified operation accepts status, headers and a generator callback, then pumps, frames and terminates the stream internally. Handlers see no chunk handle at all.
criteria.reader_pipe: Status plus headers plus a borrowed reader define the response, and the runtime relays that reader's bytes. Responders reuse producers built elsewhere.
criteria.writer_pair: Status and headers first yield a waiting response; one companion call releases its writer; the handler emits with the shared write helper, closes, and hands the response back.

response_stream.instructions: What handler-facing structure should response streaming take?

criteria.arg_send: A single variadic-feeling send carries writer, data, event, id and retry positionally, blanks denoting omission. The catalogue learns no event record.
criteria.raw_stream: Event framing stays a handler-side formatting chore over raw byte writes, with zero catalogue support and zero adapter validation.
criteria.record_send: One record bundles data, event, id and retry with blank-means-omitted semantics. Sending validates the frame and bars embedded breaks; commenting emits heartbeat remarks.

sse_shape.instructions: Which packaging serves event pushes best?

state: Can's HTTP serving sits atop Bun.serve at the pinned 1.4.2 release. Present ingress swallows each request payload pre-routing within the server cap, answers over-cap payloads with the unconditional pre-handler 413, and lets buffered body, JSON and form helpers replay retained bytes; tests lock in every clause. The B1-05 pull kit is ready: opaque byte readers and writers, read_many under a per-piece ceiling, write_some reporting accepted counts, close plus cancel, no read-ahead, no cumulative ceiling. B1-06 orders genuinely incremental intake via read_many under per-piece ceilings, exposing piece order, true connection loss, framing breaches and consumption breaches; rereads of spent bodies must fail; lagging clients must bound response buffering through backpressure; routes must include PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS and HEAD; TLS and event pushes join the surface. Probe ledger: request.body flows live and neglect never delays replies; cancel-then-reply succeeds; vanishing clients reject pending server reads with AbortError as the request signal trips; HEAD payloads disappear natively; header views already isolate Set-Cookie both ways; a response dying mid-flow lands as a silently clipped 200. Non-negotiables: catalogue-only growth, grammar frozen; the 413 and replay pins persist unless this verdict consciously shifts them; ownership flows open into closing into closed with request-bound handles; this counsel stays advisory against acceptance proof.
